description: 基于OpenStack etcd3gw 2.7.0实现Coordinator现有EtcdV3Client的Range/Txn/Lease网络映射、只读endpoint故障转移，以及低层HTTP Watch server-streaming完整响应包络解析；一次性三节点etcd v3.7.0环境已验证mTLS/RBAC、Token生命周期、成员/法定人数故障、少数派网络分区、Driver读取failover、Txn未知结果、Lease续租失败、自然过期和Leader KV fencing；Watch不支持双向WatchProgress/WatchCancel。；第五十九轮已验证少数派分区下LeaseRevoke单endpoint单次派发、OUTCOME_UNKNOWN及恢复后显式核对/清理；下一轮计划验证lease-bound key Watch DELETE与断流恢复。

no enterprise test level is approved
attributes.single_member_outage_scope: Disposable three-member etcd v3.7.0 CI cluster; one member stopped, remaining 2/3 quorum completed linearizable Range/Txn Put/readback, stopped member restored.
attributes.quorum_loss_test_scope: Disposable three-member etcd v3.7.0 CI cluster; two members stopped; lone survivor rejected linearizable reads and did not commit the attempted write; after restarting members, a linearizable read confirmed the key absent and a fresh CAS write/readback succeeded.
attributes.watch_event_default_enum: Missing/zero proto3 enum type is interpreted as PUT; DELETE is explicit; unknown values fail closed.
attributes.watch_cancel_behavior: close HTTP response stream; no server cancellation acknowledgement is exposed
attributes.watch_stream_resume: linearizable Range snapshot followed by Watch from R+1; no automatic replay
attributes.auth_token_replacement_scope: all configured endpoint HTTP sessions; Watch reuses those sessions
attributes.auth_token_error_failover_policy: authentication and authorization exceptions are not transport failures and must not trigger endpoint failover
attributes.network_partition_scope: Disposable etcd v3.7.0 three-member CI Compose network: etcd1 was disconnected from the isolated project network; its local linearizable etcdctl Range and Put both failed; etcd2/etcd3 committed one Coordinator Store CAS transaction; finally all three members recovered and etcd1 read back the majority-committed value.
attributes.network_partition_driver_scope: Disposable etcd v3.7.0 three-member CI Compose: linearizable Range first attempted isolated etcd1 then healthy majority etcd2 and succeeded; CAS Txn against isolated etcd1 was sent once and returned OUTCOME_UNKNOWN/ConnectionError; after network/quorum restoration a linearizable read confirmed the unique transaction key was not committed. No replay.
attributes.lease_partition_scope: Disposable etcd v3.7.0 three-member CI Compose: client configured all 3 endpoints but after etcd1 isolation KeepAlive dispatched once to 127.0.0.1:23791 and returned AuthorityStoreUnavailableError; majority-side TTL decreased 7s to 5s, lease naturally expired (ttl=-1), and linearizable Range confirmed attached leader key deletion. New Lease-bound owner advanced fencing epoch 1->2; stale epoch-1 CAS write failed, epoch-2 write succeeded; recovered etcd1 observed epoch 2 and the successor state.
attributes.next_task: Lease-bound authority key Watch DELETE event and stream-disconnect recovery

notes: Etcd3gw 2.7.0 is an OpenStack-maintained third-party etcd v3 gRPC-gateway client. The adapter implements Range/Txn/Lease only; read-only operations may try another configured endpoint after transport failure, while mutating operations are sent once to preserve unknown-outcome semantics. Ten fake-gateway contract unit tests are in default CI. Five live cluster tests are opt-in and were not run in this round. The Compose topology is plaintext local-only and not a production profile. Watch remains unavailable until a driver preserves the complete server response envelope. Existing SQLite business service is not migrated; schema-v2 remains sole production authority. Final code commit 871fe0d2673fb1b39502236568dc7dd57ad3bef0 passed both required jobs in CI Run 45832644686: 499 tests completed (494 passed, 5 opt-in live-etcd tests skipped), CH12 143 numerical tests passed, strict knowledge lint 0 errors; separate CH17 fixture validator 0 errors/5 expected governance warnings; the separate CH17 synthetic fixture validator passed with 0 errors and 5 existing governance warnings (DRAFT dataset, no approved enterprise environment or level, 30 SPAT source cases NOT_RUN, and manifest checksum pending). No live etcd cluster was started; skipped tests are not integration evidence. Fourth-eighth round follow-up: Run 45839556952 started a disposable three-member etcd v3.7.0 cluster and passed all 6 live integration tests, including one-member stop, linearizable read failover, 2/3 majority Txn write/readback and member restoration. Fifth-round Watch stream update: Etcd3gwV3Client now exposes a closeable raw HTTP Gateway server-streaming Watch iterator, bypassing the high-level etcd3gw watcher that filtered response control fields. It preserves header revision, watch_id, created/canceled, compact_revision, cancel_reason, fragment, events, KV and prev_kv; supports arbitrary HTTP chunk boundaries and proto3 omitted default PUT enum. WatchCreate supports progress_notify but explicit bidirectional WatchProgress/WatchCancel and server cancellation acknowledgement remain unavailable; close releases the HTTP response. Stream establishment may try another endpoint; established stream disconnect is propagated without automatic replay, requiring linearizable Range + R+1.
